Title: LSJ - Heaven's Gate & Young Bloods and others...

Messages.Author: lambach
Messages.Body:
1. How would these two cards work if a player uses a Heaven's Gate to
keep his Young blood alive? Would the opposing minion gain two blood?
We have this doubt last night as Heaven's Gate says "...when an ally is
burned in combat" not ..."when an ally would be burned in combat".
Would Yong blood (or any other Ally) return untapped if it was tapped
during the action?

Heaven's Gate
Type: Combat
Requires: Obeah/Necromancy
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable by a ready untapped vampire not involved in combat.
[nec] Prevent 1 damage to an ally in combat.
[obe] Only usable when an ally is burned in combat. Move that ally to
his or her controller's uncontrolled region (controlled, but not ready)
instead. Put 1 life on the ally from the blood bank if he or she has no
life.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but add up to 2 life to the ally, not to exceed
his or her starting amount.

Young Bloods
Type: Ally
Cost: 2 pool
Unique mortal with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
The Young Bloods can burn 2 blood from a tapped vampire with a capacity
less than 8 as a +1 stealth (D) action. If a vampire controlled by
another Methuselah burns the Young Bloods in combat or as an action, he
or she gains 2 blood.

2. This is an old one but people here keep saying a minion can't steal
blood from retainers so I am asking an official position. Can an
opposing minon steal blood from a retainer at long range?

3. Just needing a clarification here. Black Forest Base is a location
you control but any sabbat vampire from others Mathuselahs can call the
referendum to gain two pool, right? (I don't remember any other
location that allow others Mathuselahs but its controller to use its
abillities so the strange feeling)

Black Forest Base
Type: Master
Requires: sabbat
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Once each turn, a Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to give his or
her controller 2 pool from the blood bank as a +1 stealth political
action. Any Changeling may burn this card as a +1 stealth (D) action.

Thank you.
